meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 它会分析整个代码库,把功能拆成流程图,找出重复实现,给出统一架构建议,并生成报告文件和可直接交给 /make-plan 的实施提示。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说出「找到理想路径」「统一重复系统」「重构前审查架构」这类要求时触发。

say.text: 找出理想路径,分析所有功能流程。
say.note: 启动 Phase 0 功能发现,绘制分组流程图。

say.text: 统一重复的系统,给出合并方案。
say.note: 触发跨功能重复扫描并生成统一提议。

say.text: 重构前审计一下架构,列出重复点。
say.note: 产出重复报告与 /make-plan 交接提示。

howto.what_en: It maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, spots duplicated concerns, proposes a unified architecture, and writes report files plus /make-plan handoff prompts. It never writes implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find the ideal path, unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Find the ideal path and analyze all feature flows.
say_en.note: Starts Phase 0 feature discovery and flowcharts.

say_en.text: Unify the duplicated systems and propose a merge plan.
say_en.note: Runs cross-feature duplication hunt and proposal.

say_en.text: Audit the architecture before refactoring and list duplicates.
